notes: One STL with a declared 224.803 x 92.300 x 69.051 mm envelope and a creator installation photograph. Original Printables model 1507503; verify console variant, interference and the public-domain declaration before import. 2026-10-15: same asset as SRC-3DGO-993-964-CUP-HOLDER (Printables model 1507503). On 2026-10-15 the original Printables page (model 1507503) was not readable: printables.com/robots.txt allows all agents except /world/, but the model page returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge ('Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client. No Internet Archive capture of that page is indexed. The public-domain statement rests only on Renn 3D Parts and the 3D GO index, so redistribution is set to unknown, matching the twin record, until the licence is read on the original page.
